title: Retinue
summary: RET'INUE, noun [Latin retineo; re and tenco, to hold.] The attendants of a prince or distinguished personage, chiefly on a journey or an excursion; a train of persons.

inlines.v: RET'INUE, noun [Latin retineo; re and tenco, to hold.] The attendants of a prince or distinguished personage, chiefly on a journey or an excursion; a train of persons.
